name: JoAi: Enroll in Loyalty Program

description.en: Enroll an existing contact in the team's loyalty program. The contact receives their digital loyalty card and can start collecting points immediately. Use after finding or creating the contact.
description.de: Melde einen vorhandenen Kontakt im Treueprogramm des Teams an. Der Kontakt erhält seine digitale Treuekarte und kann sofort Punkte sammeln. Nach dem Anlegen oder Suchen des Kontakts verwenden.

bot: Use this after finding or creating a contact to enroll them in the loyalty program. The contact will receive their pass link automatically.

inputs.name: Contact ID
inputs.bot: The hash ID returned by find-or-create contact.
